request: Build a flappy bird game in a single HTML file. A bird falls with gravity and flaps with space or a click, pipes spawn at random gap positions on a timer that speeds up as the score rises, passing a pipe scores a point, hitting a pipe or the ground ends the game showing final and best scores, the best score persists in localStorage, and a restart resets the world.

intent.goal: build a flappy bird game in a single html file.

planFiles.summary: Flappy Bird HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file
